name: Heiterwang am See
kurzbeschreibung: Charming spot by Heiterwanger See, featuring a lakeside promenade and excursion boats.
beschreibung:
Overview

Heiterwang am See is situated at an altitude of 994 metres in the Außerfern region within the district of Reutte, nestled in the Tiroler Zugspitz Arena. The idyllic municipality covers roughly 36 square kilometres in the historical Zwischentoren valley and is home to around 540 residents. Resting at the foot of the prominent Thaneller mountain, the village is renowned above all for scenic Lake Heiterwang (Heiterwanger See), a fjord-like mountain lake framed by steep forested slopes and connected via a navigable channel to Lake Plansee. Heiterwang charms visitors with its calm rural pace, unspoilt natural beauty, and wide array of recreation for water lovers, hikers, and relaxation seekers year-round.

History

The first documented mention of Heiterwang dates back to the year 1315. Earlier records from the Tyrolean land register of 1288 already noted valuable fishing fiefs on Lake Heiterwang, which was later treasured by Tyrolean sovereigns such as Archduke Sigismund the Rich and Emperor Maximilian I for royal hunting and angling; Sigismund even erected the lakeside hunting lodge Sigmundsweid in 1478. Situated along the strategic Fern Pass trade corridor, the village endured frequent military incursions. The heritage-listed parish church of Our Lady of the Assumption traces back to a 14th-century chapel, was rebuilt in Gothic style around 1480, and received Baroque embellishments in the mid-18th century. Another solemn historic site is the ancient plague burial ground am Grund, commemorating victims of the Thirty Years' War.

Getting There

By automobile, Heiterwang is readily reached via the Fernpass federal highway B179, whether approaching from the north via Reutte and Füssen or from the south via Telfs and the Fern Pass. Train passengers travel on the historic Außerfern Railway: Heiterwang-Plansee station is served by direct regional train services operated by ÖBB and Deutsche Bahn, providing convenient connections to Reutte, Kempten, Garmisch-Partenkirchen, and Munich. In addition, VVT regional bus services stop in the village centre and near the lakeshore.

Tips

Lake Heiterwang is the undisputed jewel of the resort: From May to October, the passenger boats MS Margarethe and MS Wilhelm operate along Austria's highest commercial passenger shipping line, connecting Heiterwang with scenic docks on Lake Plansee. A six-kilometre lakeside path circuits the crystal-clear waters, which also attract anglers, stand-up paddleboarders, rowers, and scuba divers. For mountaineers, ascending the 2,341-metre Thaneller peak delivers sweeping panoramic vistas across the Zugspitze massif and the Lechtal Alps. In winter, cross-country ski trails, peaceful winter walks, and nearby Zugspitz Arena ski resorts guarantee rewarding recreation.
